name: Streaming Tetrahedral Mesh Format
definition: A data layout that interleaves vertices and tetrahedral cells on disk to allow coherent sequential access and out-of-core processing, where vertices are introduced when needed and finalized when no longer used.
summary: Streaming Tetrahedral Mesh Format is a disk layout that interleaves vertex and cell data to enable low-memory, out-of-core processing of tetrahedral meshes.
